title: ApplicationCollaboration
description: TOGAF-sourced representation archetype — an end-to-end representation of multiple Application Components working together to deliver functionality. A cross-structural representation: the collaborating components are independent Structures; the collaboration defines their coordinated behavior pattern. Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Application Collaboration (Content Metamodel, Application Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Application Architecture, Content Framework).

collaborationType.description: Collaboration coordination pattern. POINT_TO_POINT = direct bilateral. CHOREOGRAPHY = decentralized coordination. ORCHESTRATION = centrally coordinated. TOGAF mapping: Application Collaboration pattern.

participantCount.description: Number of participating Application Components. TOGAF mapping: Application Collaboration scope.
